sanskrit: taṃ somaḥ praty amuñcata draviṇāya rasāya kam | so asmai maha id duhe (…) ||
english: Soma fastened that amulet upon him — for wealth, for vital sap, verily. It milked greatness for him (…).

sanskrit: taṃ bibhrac candramā maṇim asurāṇāṃ puro 'jayad dānavānāṃ hiraṇyayīḥ so asmai teja id duhe (…) ||
english: The Moon, bearing that jewel, conquered the citadels of the Asuras, the golden strongholds of the Dānavas. It milked lustre for him (…).

sanskrit: taṃ rājā varuṇo maṇiṃ praty amuñcata śaṃbhuvaṃ so asmai rājyaṃ duhe (…) ||
english: King Varuṇa fastened upon him that amulet, the well-being-granting one. It milked sovereignty for him (…).

sanskrit: taṃ tvaṣṭā praty amuñcata prajābhyo vīryāya kaṃ so asmai rūpam id duhe (…) ||
english: Tvaṣṭṛ fastened that amulet upon him — for progeny, for heroic vigour. It milked beauty of form for him (…).

sanskrit: taṃ bibhrat savitā maṇiṃ tenedam ajayat svaḥ so asmai sūnṛtāṃ duhe (…) ||
english: Savitṛ, bearing that jewel, conquered the heavenly realm with it. It milked gracious speech for him (…).

sanskrit: tam āpo bibhratīr maṇiṃ sadā dhāvanty akṣitāḥ sa ābhyo amṛtaṃ duhe (…) ||
english: The Waters, bearing that jewel, flow on for ever, inexhaustible. It milked immortality for them (…).

sanskrit: tenemāṃ maṇinā kṛṣim aśvināv abhi rakṣataḥ sa bhiṣagbhyāṃ payo duhe (…) ||
english: With that jewel the two Aśvins guard this farmland. It milked milk for the two healers (…).

sanskrit: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir vātāya maṇim āśave so asmai vācam id duhe (…) ||
english: The amulet which Bṛhaspati bound for swift Vāta — it milked sacred speech for him (…).

sanskrit: taṃ devā bibhrato maṇiṃ sarvām̐l lokān yudhājayan sa ebhyo jitam id duhe (…) ||
english: The gods, bearing that jewel, conquered all the worlds in battle. It milked conquest for them (…).

sanskrit: tam imaṃ devatā maṇiṃ tubhyaṃ dadhatu bhartave sa u te bhūtim id duhām | bhūyobhūyaḥ śvaḥśvas tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
english: May the deities place this jewel upon you to be worn; may it milk prosperity for you indeed. Again and again, day after day, with it do you smite your foes.

sanskrit: antardeśā abadhnata pradiśas tam abadhnata | prajāpatisṛṣṭo maṇir dviṣato me adharām̐ akaḥ ||
english: The intermediate quarters fastened it; the cardinal directions fastened that amulet. The jewel brought forth by Prajāpati has laid my enemies low.

sanskrit: ṛtavas tam abadhnata- -ārtavās tam abadhnata | saṃvatsaras taṃ baddhvā sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ vi rājati ||
english: The seasons fastened it; the seasonal divisions fastened that amulet. The year, having bound it, shines sovereign over all existing beings.

sanskrit: atharvāṇo abadhnata- -ātharvāṇā abadhnata | aṅgirasas taṃ baddhvā dasyūnāṃ bibidhuḥ puraḥ ||
english: The Atharvaṇas fastened it; the Ātharvaṇas fastened that amulet. The Aṅgirasas, having bound it, split open the strongholds of the Dasyus.

sanskrit: taṃ dhātā praty amuñcata sa bhūtāny akalpayat | tena tvaṃ dviṣato jahi ||
english: Dhātṛ fastened that amulet; with it he fashioned all existing creatures. With it do you smite your foes.

sanskrit: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim | sa tvāyaṃ maṇir āgamat saha gobhir ajāvibhir annena prajayā saha ||
english: The amulet which Bṛhaspati bound for the gods as protection against the Asuras — that jewel has come to you together with cattle, with goats and sheep, with food and with offspring.

sanskrit: (…) | (…) āgaman madhor ghṛtasya dhārayā kilālena śriyā saha ||
english: (…) they have come with a stream of honey and ghee, with sweet drink, together with splendour.

sanskrit: yam abadhnād bṛhaspatir devebhyo asurakṣitim | sa tvāyaṃ maṇir āgamad ojasā tejasā sahasā bhūtyā draviṇena śriyā saha ||
english: The amulet which Bṛhaspati bound for the gods as protection against the Asuras — that jewel has come to you with vital power, with lustre, with might, with prosperity, with wealth, together with splendour.

sanskrit: yasya lokā ime trayaḥ payo dugdham upāsate | sa tvāyam abhi rakṣatu maṇiḥ śraiṣṭhyāya mūrdhataḥ ||
english: He whose milk these three worlds attend as something milked — may that jewel protect you from above for pre-eminence.

sanskrit: sa tvāyaṃ śatadakṣiṇo maṇiḥ śraiṣṭhyāya jinvatu | yaṃ devāḥ pitaro manuṣyā upajīvanti sarvadā ||
english: May that jewel of hundredfold capacity quicken you for pre-eminence — that jewel upon which gods, Pitṛs, and human beings continually depend for their sustenance.

sanskrit: yasmai tvā yajñavardhana maṇe pratyamucaṃ śivam | taṃ tvaṃ śatadakṣiṇa maṇe śraiṣṭhyāya jinvatāt ||
english: O amulet that augments the sacrifice, I have fastened you, auspicious one, upon this man — him do you, O jewel of hundredfold capacity, quicken to pre-eminence.

sanskrit: asapatnaḥ sapatnahā sapatnān me adharām̐ akaḥ | uttaraṃ dviṣatas tvā maṇiḥ kṛṇotu devajāḥ ||
english: Without rivals, slayer of rivals, it has laid my rivals low. May this jewel, born of the gods, make you superior over your adversary.

sanskrit: maṇiṃ sahasravīryaṃ brahmaṇā tejasā saha prati muñcāmi te śivam | sa tvāyam abhi rohatu devaiḥ phālamaṇiḥ saha ||
english: The jewel of thousandfold power, auspicious — I fasten it upon you together with sacred formulation and lustre. May this plough-jewel mount upon you together with the gods.

sanskrit: yathā bījam urvarāyāṃ kṛṣṭe phālena rohati | evāsmin prajā paśavo annamannaṃ vi rohatu ||
english: As the seed sprouts in the fertile field when ploughed with the ploughshare, so may progeny, cattle, and food upon food flourish in him.

sanskrit: etam idhmaṃ samābhṛtaṃ juṣāṇo agne prati harya homam | tasmin videma sumatiṃ svasti cakṣuḥ prāṇaṃ prajāṃ paśūn jātavedasi brahmaṇā ||
english: O Agni, being pleased, welcome this fire-wood duly gathered, welcome the oblation. May we find in him — in Jātavedas — through sacred formulation, benevolence, well-being, sight, breath, offspring, and cattle.
